overall_assessment: Section extraction for inn works well: all 20 courses (Norwegian and English page variants) have content, outcomes, methods, coursework (arbeidskrav / obligatoriske aktiviteter) and assessment in the right sections, with nothing lost; placeholders such as 'Ingen pensumliste' are correctly not emitted. All three pre-pass flags are false alarms. Remaining issues are low-severity noise: the exam table and aids boilerplate in assessment, lost Kunnskap/Ferdigheter sub-headings, and generic text in teaching_methods.

findings.evidence: Kalkulator i tråd med retningslinjer for kalkulatorbruk på de økonomisk/administrative studiene ved Handelshøgskolen Innlandet – Fakultet for økonomi og samfunnsvitenskap. Oppdaterte retningslinjer foreligger og formidles til studentene ved oppstart av hvert studieår.
findings.description: Every assessment starts with the flattened exam table (header row 'Vurderingsordning Karakterskala Gruppe/individuell Varighet Hjelpemidler Andel Kommentarer' plus a data row with duration, aids, share). The Kommentarer cell often holds the same boilerplate about calculator rules, repeated across courses. This is exam logistics (aids, durations), not assessment design, and the section is not clean.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The exam table is read as a tab-separated text line by the block reader and kept whole; .clean_sections() does not strip the table header/row or the calculator-guideline sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the table header line and the table data row (or keep only the exam form and grade scale) in .clean_sections() for INN assessment, and add the calculator-guideline sentence to the assessment boilerplate strip list.

findings.description: Content is complete, but the sub-headings Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse are consumed and replaced by a bare, repeated 'Studenten' line, so the split into knowledge, skills and general competence is lost. In KS4102 even the 'Studenten' marker is absent, leaving three groups separated only by blank lines.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-headings mapped to learning_outcomes are used as boundaries in sectionize() in R/extract_sections.R but their text is not emitted.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the sub-heading lines as text inside learning_outcomes (Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse and the English equivalents).

findings.evidence:
Emneevaluering – kvalitetssystem

Til vanlig skal det gjennomføres evaluering av alle emner. Tidspunkt og metode avgjøres i samråd med tillitsvalgte studenter. Emneansvarlig har ansvar for at evalueringen gjennomføres.
findings.description: Sub-blocks under Arbeids- og undervisningsformer that are not teaching methods are appended to teaching_methods: the course-evaluation quality-system paragraph (LAN2300) and the generic Praksisstudiet paragraph shared by teacher-education courses (KRLE). This is boilerplate / admin text, not teaching methods, so the section is not clean.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The sub-headings 'Emneevaluering' and 'Praksis' have no pattern in R/section_heading_map.R, so their text continues the preceding teaching_methods section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map the heading 'Emneevaluering – kvalitetssystem' to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R; consider dropping the generic Praksisstudiet paragraph in .clean_sections().
